Samira (AE): Hey team — HearthFin POC went live this morning. Jordan from their infra team pinged me with a couple of blockers: certificate rotation cadence for SAML metadata, SCIM bulk provisioning limits, and whether we can map their nested role hierarchy into our RBAC. @Priya can you take the SCIM + RBAC part?
Priya (SE): On it. quick q — are they planning SCIM delta patches or full syncs? that affects batch size and rate limits.
Jordan (Prospect): We want delta patches for daily sync, but initial backfill will be ~120k users. need to know safe throttling and if we need a staging window.
Alex (Infra): 120k initial backfill -> recommend staging in chunks. our hosted API can handle continuous imports but for that scale use our bulk import endpoint with recommended concurrency 8 and a 200ms inter-request delay to avoid throttles. alternatively Dedicated with reserved throughput removes those limits.
Priya (SE): For delta patches we'll accept PATCH operations per RFC7644. sample snippet: ```PATCH /Users/123 { "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{"op":"replace","path":"roles","value":["team:payments:read"]}] }``` map their nested roles -> we can flatten to role IDs and preserve namespace in metadata.
Maya (Security): On the SAML cert rotation: they require automated rollover every 45 days and want encrypted assertions. we support rotating x509 certs with a key-id header; rotation can be done zero-downtime if both old+new certs are accepted for 7 days. need to confirm their IdP supports sign+encrypt.
Jordan (Prospect): Ok that helps. also: can you expose audit logs per tenant and ship to our SIEM (Splunk)? and do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)?
Alex (Infra): We can stream audit events to a pub/sub sink or push to your Splunk HTTP Event Collector. customer-managed KMS for private deployments only (VPC / on-prem). hosted customers can request Bring-Your-Own-Key in limited regions — will check availability.
Samira (AE): Pricing question — they asked for cost delta between hosted + higher rate limits vs Redwood Dedicated reserved pool. Jordan asked for a ballpark monthly for 2x baseline throughput and dedicated SLAs.
Priya (SE): Quick estimate: Hosted + bulk import support + higher concurrency = usage + a premium support add-on; Dedicated (small pool) runs ~$Xk/month with predictable p99 latency. I can draft a more exact quote after we know target qps and token volume.
Jordan (Prospect): We also have a security questionnaire (30+ items) around encryption at rest, SOC2, pen test cadence, and certificate management. can someone own answers?
Maya (Security): I'll take the questionnaire. send it here or to security@redwood.ai. FYI we have SOC2 Type II, annual pen tests, and KMS integration notes.
deploy-bot: "deploy: staging/scim-import v2 deployed by ci/cd — see https://ci.redwood.ai/build/7788"
Samira (AE): Next steps: @Priya draft SCIM import plan + RBAC mapping template for HearthFin; @Maya start questionnaire responses; @Alex confirm KMS availability for hosted in eu-west; I'll schedule a technical review call with Jordan for Thursday 10am PT.
Priya (SE): will prep role mapping CSV template and an idempotent import playbook.
Alex (Infra): Confirmed — checking BYOK availability for eu-west, will update by EOD.
Maya (Security): I'll attach SOC2 and pen-test summary on the call.
Jordan (Prospect): Thanks all — if we can get staging import runbook and cert rotation diagram before Thursday that would be ideal.
Samira (AE): Copy that. I'll upload the docs to the shared drive and invite Jordan. :thumbsup:
Priya (SE): one last note — if they want live SCIM sync we need to confirm they support incremental change tokens. otherwise we'll recommend a periodic delta with tombstone handling.
Jordan (Prospect): They do support change tokens via Okta. thanks, see you Thursday.
